reviewer: training_auditor agent, independent of primary review_judge
scope: All 48 natural outputs of the new repeated-holdout update25/update100 diagnostic; exact prompt, full response and production parser assessment.
production_usable: The unchanged production parseReview accepts the full response and available changed-line citations. Parser acceptance alone does not imply semantic correctness.
concern_pass: At least one concrete causal defect supported by the shown code and local rules, with an available causally appropriate changed-line citation. Every material claim and every finding must be supported; no unsupported extra allegations.
clean_pass: The production parser accepts an empty findings array. A nonempty finding labeled Clean is not an empty review.
grounding: A valid alternative wording or noncanonical changed-line citation is allowed if its causal link is supported. Merely quoting changed syntax or an abstract rule without identifying the violated mechanism is insufficient.
precision: Awkward language can pass when the concrete causal claim is intelligible. Record accepted and stricter readings for material ambiguity; never silently shift the criterion.
sensitivity: For every materially ambiguous response, explain the causal reading accepted or rejected and the corresponding strict outcome. Report pair counts under both readings.
pairs: A pair passes only if its concern and clean outputs both pass completely; no substitution of first-token choice or concern presence.
independence: Do not read primary-judgments files or messages conveying primary outcomes before completing this secondary assessment. Do not copy historical counts. Generation metadata/completeness checks are permitted.
